fields.description: The fields shown to the participant (default: the uses: fields, or the of: value alone); validated as uses: (SPEC §7)

template.description: A text template rendered per record — {{field}} placeholders — shown instead of the field listing

render.description: What the participant is shown per record (ADR-049)

provides.description: The step's derived provides schema (ADR-033) — the menu the participant answers. Injected by the runner from the step-level provides: key — never authored inside with:.

of.description: The referent (ADR-048): the field whose value this step is about. Injected by the runner from the step-level of: key — never authored inside with:.

prompt.description: tty (default): at a terminal, `gtme run` walks the records and asks; never: every record waits in the ledger for `gtme answer` (ADR-049)
